name: beyond_create_requirements
description: For authorized project setup with supplied requirements, save traceable DRAFT records, verify saved IDs, then ask focused gap questions; do not stop after reading. Deduplicate against existing records first. Atomically create requirements. Optional project-unique requirement_code is generated if omitted. Missing required fields fail the entire batch. Default response_detail=compact; use full only when complete saved records are needed. Responses embed current/next-stage guide text and disclose server-generated values; no separate guide query is required.

requirement_status.description: Suggested convention when the project/user has none; custom existing values remain valid: {'DRAFT': 'Unconfirmed', 'CONFIRMED': 'Agreed scope', 'ON_HOLD': 'Deferred', 'EXCLUDED': 'Out of scope'}

dev_phase.description: Suggested convention when the project/user has none; custom existing values remain valid: {'MVP': 'Initial minimum scope', 'Phase 1': 'First delivery', 'Phase 2': 'Later delivery'}

requirement_priority.description: Suggested convention when the project/user has none; custom existing values remain valid: {'ordering': 'Lower numbers mean higher priority under this suggested convention.', 'examples': {'1': 'High', '5': 'Medium', '10': 'Normal (schema default)'}}

response_detail.description: Compact returns identities and automatic-value receipts without echoing input bodies. Full returns complete saved records.

output_contract_note: No outputSchema is declared by the inspected public source definition. Consult live help and actual results; do not infer a missing output contract.
